title: Pocketwire Rewards Goodwill Amount Standard: The Courtesy Credit
content:
The Pocketwire Rewards courtesy tier amount is the courtesy points amount of the tier held on the credit date, and the courtesy credit for a late redemption is that courtesy tier amount, in whole points.

## Calculation

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Tier held on the credit date | the membership record on the day the courtesy credit is booked |
| Courtesy points amount of that tier | the product's tier figure, the courtesy points amount per late fulfilment |

The points credited are the courtesy tier amount as a whole number of points.

## Worked examples (hypothetical memberships)

- The tier held on the credit date has a courtesy points amount of 1500. The courtesy credit is 1500 points.
- A membership redeemed on one tier and moved to another at a quarterly review before the courtesy credit was booked. The tier held on the credit date sets the amount.

## Basis question

Which tier decides the amount? The tier held on the credit date, whichever tier the membership held when the redemption was made.
